items.source: Get the merged ContextCustomizers that will be applied when the application context is loaded.
items.translation: 获取将在加载应用程序上下文时应用的合并ContextCustomizers。

items.source: Uses of ContextCustomizer in org.springframework.test.context
items.translation: `org.springframework.test.context` 包中 `ContextCustomizer` 的用法

items.source: Create a ContextCustomizer that should be used to customize a ConfigurableApplicationContext before it is refreshed.
items.translation: 创建一个 ContextCustomizer，用于在刷新之前自定义一个 ConfigurableApplicationContext。

items.source: This package contains the Spring TestContext Framework which provides annotation-driven unit and integration testing support that is agnostic of the actual testing framework in use.
items.translation: 该包包含Spring TestContext 框架，它提供与所使用的实际测试框架无关的基于注解的单元测试和集成测试支持。
